events.event: Polar Bear Gathering on Hudson Bay
events.hook: Hundreds of polar bears gather on the tundra to wait for the bay to freeze, and you watch from a tundra buggy.
events.overview: Each autumn Churchill hosts the world's most reliable polar bear viewing as bears wait on the shore for sea ice to form. Tundra buggy excursions put you at eye level with them, and the northern lights often appear above the town on clear nights. The peak window closes as the ice forms in mid to late November.
events.costNotes: Tundra buggy days run several hundred dollars each and Churchill lodging is scarce and pricey.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Yellowknife, Canada","event":"Aurora viewing season","note":"Reliable northern lights with aurora-viewing lodges and cabins."},{"destination":"Svalbard, Norway","event":"Polar night and Arctic wildlife season","note":"A far-north alternative with a very different Arctic feel, though bear sightings are less guaranteed."}]

events.event: Fiestas de Independencia and Reinado Nacional de Belleza
events.hook: Street parties, comparsas and drumming fill the walled city for Cartagena's independence celebrations.
events.overview: Cartagena marks its Nov 11, 1811 independence with parades, music, dance and beauty-pageant events through the Old Town and Getsemaní. There are costumed street comparsas, champeta and cumbia, and rum-fuelled nights. The long holiday weekend brings Colombians in from across the country.
events.costNotes: Holiday-weekend lodging is expensive, so book early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Barranquilla, Colombia","event":"Caribbean coast nightlife and music","note":"A lively coastal city, though its big Carnival is in February."},{"destination":"Santa Marta, Colombia","event":"Tayrona coast and Sierra Nevada","note":"A quieter Caribbean base for beaches and hiking."}]

events.hook: The Pink City turns into a sea of oil lamps, fireworks and lit-up bazaars on the biggest night of the Hindu calendar.
events.overview: Diwali falls on Nov 8, 2026, and Jaipur's markets such as Johari and Bapu Bazaar are strung with lights and decorations for the five-day run. Families light diyas, set off fireworks and share sweets, and the old city and hilltop forts glow at night. It is a very immersive way to see the festival.
events.costNotes: Flights and stays are at last-minute peak festival pricing, so book immediately.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Varanasi, India","event":"Diwali ghats and Ganga lamp-lighting, building to Dev Deepawali on Nov 24","note":"Thousands of lamps line the river steps for the entire Kartik month."},{"destination":"Amritsar, India","event":"Bandi Chhor Divas at the Golden Temple","note":"The Sikh Diwali, with the temple and its pool lit by thousands of lamps."}]

events.hook: Dhow races, donkey races and Swahili poetry on a car-free UNESCO island.
events.overview: Lamu Old Town is the best-preserved Swahili settlement in East Africa, and its annual cultural festival celebrates that heritage. Expect dhow sailing races, donkey races, henna art, traditional dance and Swahili cooking. Few tourists come, so the festival still feels local.
events.costNotes: The flights connect through Nairobi, with a short domestic hop to Lamu.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Zanzibar, Tanzania","event":"Stone Town culture and spice season","note":"Swahili heritage with more tourist infrastructure."},{"destination":"Mozambique Island, Mozambique","event":"Swahili-Portuguese heritage town","note":"Quiet UNESCO site with a similar historic island feel."}]

events.hook: Thousands of camels, desert traders and pilgrims gather around a sacred lake on Kartik Purnima.
events.overview: Pushkar's fair is one of Rajasthan's biggest gatherings, with camel and horse trading, folk music, turban contests and cattle parades. It ends with Kartik Purnima on Nov 24, when pilgrims bathe in the lake. Dates shift slightly each year, so check the official calendar.
events.costNotes: Tents and haveli rooms near the fairground cost more in fair week.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Varanasi, India","event":"Dev Deepawali on Nov 24","note":"Ganges ghats lit with a million lamps."},{"destination":"Jodhpur, India","event":"Blue City and Mehrangarh Fort","note":"Rajasthan culture without the fair crowds."}]

events.event: Beaujolais Nouveau Day and Les Sarmentelles de Beaujeu
events.hook: The year's first Beaujolais pours at midnight, with parties across Lyon and the vineyard villages.
events.overview: Beaujolais Nouveau is released on the third Thursday of November, and Les Sarmentelles de Beaujeu is the traditional kickoff, with parades, tastings and music in the wine villages north of Lyon. Pair it with Lyon's bouchon restaurants and food markets. It is a good trip for food and wine lovers.
events.costNotes: Lyon is a direct or one-stop flight from LAX in shoulder season.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Alba, Italy","event":"International White Truffle Fair","note":"Truffle markets and tastings through early December."},{"destination":"Porto, Portugal","event":"Sao Martinho and Magusto chestnut and wine feasts (Nov 11)","note":"Chestnuts and young wine in cozy local tascas."}]

events.hook: F1 cars screaming down the Strip at night, a short flight from LAX.
events.overview: The Las Vegas Grand Prix is a night race on a street circuit past the Bellagio fountains, the Sphere and the casinos. Race week brings concerts, parties and a lot of spectacle. It is an easy trip from LAX, though hotel prices spike.
events.costNotes: Race-week lodging and tickets are very expensive, so consider a shorter stay.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Doha, Qatar","event":"Qatar Grand Prix (around Nov 27-29)","note":"A floodlit F1 weekend at the Lusail circuit."},{"destination":"Mexico City, Mexico","event":"City nightlife and food scene","note":"A big-city alternative on the same American continent, reachable from LAX in about 4 hours."}]

events.hook: Thousands of paper lanterns drift into the night sky above Chiang Mai.
events.overview: Loy Krathong falls on the full moon on Nov 24, and in northern Thailand it coincides with Yi Peng, the lantern-release festival. Locals float krathong baskets on the Ping River and release sky lanterns. Parades and night markets add to the scene. Book a room and any organized lantern event well ahead.
events.costNotes: The flights connect through Bangkok or an East Asian hub.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sukhothai, Thailand","event":"Loy Krathong at the historical park","note":"Ancient ruins with a candlelit atmosphere."},{"destination":"Taunggyi, Myanmar","event":"Tazaungdaing Balloon Festival","note":"A fiery balloon festival held at the same full moon, subject to travel conditions."}]

events.hook: Corals release clouds of eggs and sperm in a night-time spawning event after the full moon.
events.overview: Great Barrier Reef corals spawn within a few nights after the November full moon (Nov 24, 2026), and night dives and snorkel trips run to catch it. Timing varies by reef and year, so book flexible tours. The surrounding season is also good for diving and tropical rainforest trips.
events.costNotes: Specialist night dives and reef trips are the main expense.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Ningaloo Reef, Australia","event":"Whale shark and reef season","note":"A remote reef with whale shark encounters."},{"destination":"Fiji","event":"Soft coral diving at Taveuni","note":"Colorful reefs and warm water."}]

events.hook: One of Europe's oldest Christmas markets opens with the Christkind's prologue and gingerbread smells.
events.overview: Nuremberg's Christkindlesmarkt opens on the Friday before Advent, with a prologue from the Christkind on the Frauenkirche balcony. The stalls sell Lebkuchen, Nuremberg sausages and handmade ornaments. Day trips to Bamberg and Rothenburg fit easily.
events.costNotes: Fares are cheaper than in December.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Strasbourg, France","event":"Christkindelsmarik","note":"Alsatian Christmas markets around the cathedral."},{"destination":"Vienna, Austria","event":"Christkindlmarkt at the Rathaus","note":"Markets, concerts and palaces."}]

events.hook: Nagaland's 17 Naga tribes gather in one heritage village for ten days of war dances, rice beer and rock music.
events.overview: Held every year at Kisama Heritage Village outside Kohima, the Hornbill Festival is the 'Festival of Festivals' for Nagaland. Each tribe builds a traditional morung (hut) and performs songs, dances and sports. Evenings bring food stalls, the Naga chilli-eating contest and a rock concert. It is one of the least-visited major cultural festivals in Asia.
events.costNotes: Flights run LAX to Delhi or Kolkata, then on to Dimapur. Homestays and festival-week lodging fill early, and you need an Inner Line Permit.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Guwahati, India","event":"Gateway to the Northeast, with the Brahmaputra and Kamakhya temple","note":"A good add-on or base for onward travel to Nagaland."},{"destination":"Luang Prabang, Laos","event":"Cool-season temple towns and early-December markets","note":"A similar slow, culture-focused trip with far easier logistics."}]

events.hook: Enormous lantern-lit floats are hauled up a hill in the cold while fireworks explode over a mountain town.
events.overview: One of Japan's three great float festivals, with a 300-year history. Six huge floats carry drummers and flute players through Chichibu's streets, and the main night on Dec 3 ends with fireworks in the winter air. It is about 80 minutes from Tokyo by train but is far less crowded than Kyoto's festivals.
events.costNotes: Base yourself in Tokyo or Chichibu, and book accommodation near the festival early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kobe, Japan","event":"Kobe Luminarie light installation","note":"A winter light spectacle in early December, within reach of Osaka and Kyoto."},{"destination":"Sapporo, Japan","event":"Sapporo White Illumination","note":"Winter lights plus snow and Hokkaido seafood."}]

events.hook: All of Lyon becomes a light show, with projections on cathedrals, squares and riverbanks.
events.overview: Since 1852, Lyonnais have put candles in their windows on Dec 8 to thank the Virgin Mary. Today the tradition has grown into a four-night festival of large-scale light art across the city. Add Lyon's bouchon restaurants and you have a very good winter trip. The exact dates are announced late and usually fall around Dec 8, so verify them.
events.costNotes: Hotels and Airbnbs rise sharply on festival nights, so book early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Strasbourg, France","event":"Christkindelsmärik Christmas market","note":"One of Europe's oldest Christmas markets, running through Dec 24."},{"destination":"Nuremberg, Germany","event":"Christkindlesmarkt","note":"A classic Bavarian Christmas market with gingerbread and mulled wine."}]

events.hook: Candlelit Lucia processions and Nobel Prize ceremonies come together in the Swedish capital during the darkest days of the year.
events.overview: Nobel Day on Dec 10 brings the prize ceremony and banquet. The ceremony is by invitation only, but the city's decorations, public lectures and the Nobel Prize Museum are open to visitors. Dec 13 brings St. Lucia, with white-robed choirs, saffron buns (lussekatter) and glögg in churches and concert halls. It is a very atmospheric Scandinavian winter trip.
events.costNotes: Sweden is expensive. Lucia concerts in churches need advance tickets.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Copenhagen, Denmark","event":"Tivoli Gardens Christmas season","note":"Historic amusement park with markets and lights."},{"destination":"Rovaniemi, Finland","event":"Santa Claus Village and Lapland polar night","note":"A snowy December trip with possible aurora."}]

events.event: Day of the Virgin of Guadalupe
events.hook: Millions of pilgrims converge on the Basilica of Guadalupe in one of the world's biggest religious gatherings.
events.overview: Each year Dec 12 honours Mexico's patron saint. Pilgrims arrive on foot, by bicycle and even on their knees, with mariachi serenades, dancers and food stalls around the basilica from Dec 11 into the night. Combined with Mexico City's museums and restaurants and its December lights, it is a short, cheap flight from LAX.
events.costNotes: Mexico City is great value, and LAX flights are frequent and cheap.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Puebla, Mexico","event":"Guadalupe celebrations and Christmas traditions","note":"A colonial city with strong December food and cultural traditions."},{"destination":"Medellín, Colombia","event":"Día de las Velitas and Alumbrados lights","note":"A city lit by candles and Christmas lights from Dec 7."}]

events.hook: Afrobeats concerts, beach parties and the global African diaspora in Ghana's capital.
events.overview: Every year, Accra fills with returning Ghanaians and the diaspora for concerts, festivals and parties. Expect Afrobeats and amapiano shows, beach clubs, art shows and food from kenkey to jollof. It is a lively, high-energy trip, with cultural sights such as Cape Coast and Elmina castles nearby. Event schedules are set by promoters and change each year.
events.costNotes: Flights are usually via Europe or a connecting hub. Event tickets and accommodation spike in late December.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lagos, Nigeria","event":"December concerts and festive season","note":"A similar high-energy music scene, though logistics are more challenging."},{"destination":"Cape Town, South Africa","event":"Summer festival season and beach holiday","note":"Warm weather, live music and wine country."}]

events.event: Noche de Rábanos (Night of the Radishes)
events.hook: Artisans carve giant radishes into nativity scenes, dancers and dragons in Oaxaca's main square.
events.overview: A one-night tradition since 1897 where growers carve oversized red radishes into elaborate sculptures in the zócalo. It is a quirky, lesser-known event that most visitors never see. Combine it with Oaxaca's Christmas posadas, mezcal and mole.
events.costNotes: Flights are via Mexico City. Holiday-week prices rise, and queues for the display are long.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Guanajuato, Mexico","event":"Colonial Christmas posadas and street celebrations","note":"A colourful, walkable alternative for the holidays."},{"destination":"San Cristóbal de las Casas, Mexico","event":"Posadas and highland Christmas traditions","note":"A cool-weather highland town with strong Indigenous culture."}]

events.hook: A fleet of ocean racers leaves Sydney Harbour on Boxing Day and sails 628 nautical miles to Tasmania.
events.overview: One of the world's great blue-water races. Yachts start in Sydney Harbour on Dec 26, then finish on Hobart's Derwent River over the following days. Hobart celebrates with the Taste of Tasmania food festival on the waterfront. You can start in Sydney for the harbour start and fly to Hobart for the finish.
events.costNotes: Australian summer holiday prices are high. Book flights and accommodation early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sydney, Australia","event":"Boxing Day harbour start and New Year's Eve fireworks","note":"Watch the start from the harbour, then stay for the fireworks."},{"destination":"Melbourne, Australia","event":"Boxing Day Test at the MCG","note":"Check the 2026 schedule; the Boxing Day cricket Test is a long-running tradition."}]

events.hook: Costumed groups, goatskin drums and cowbells fill Bay Street before dawn in the Bahamas' biggest party.
events.overview: Junkanoo is a Bahamian street parade of elaborate costumes, brass bands and rushing percussion, held on Boxing Day and New Year's Day. Groups compete with handmade crepe-paper costumes, and the parade begins in the early hours and runs into the morning. It is a short flight from LAX with a connection, and it combines well with beach time.
events.costNotes: Holiday prices are high, and you should book grandstand seating in advance.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Cali, Colombia","event":"Feria de Cali","note":"A salsa festival with parades and concerts in late December."},{"destination":"San Juan, Puerto Rico","event":"Fiestas de la Calle San Sebastián and holiday season","note":"Puerto Rico's Christmas season is long and music-filled, ending in January."}]

events.hook: A Torchlight Procession, a street party for tens of thousands and fireworks over the castle for Scotland's New Year.
events.overview: Edinburgh's Hogmanay is one of the world's biggest New Year celebrations, with a Torchlight Procession, concerts, ceilidhs and fireworks over the castle. Locals follow with first-footing and Auld Lang Syne. Exact program dates are announced each autumn, so check them before booking.
events.costNotes: Accommodation is at peak prices, and street party tickets sell out.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Reykjavík, Iceland","event":"New Year's Eve bonfires and fireworks","note":"Locals set off huge amounts of fireworks and light bonfires across the city."},{"destination":"Prague, Czech Republic","event":"New Year's Eve in Old Town Square","note":"A more affordable European NYE option with Christmas markets."}]

events.event: Tweede Nuwe Jaar (Cape Minstrel Carnival / Kaapse Klopse)
events.hook: Thousands of banjo-strumming, satin-clad minstrels dance through the Cape Town streets in a 'Second New Year' parade.
events.overview: A 200-year-old Cape Malay tradition born from the day enslaved people were given off after New Year. Troupes in bright costumes march through the city with brass, banjos and choirs, and troupe competitions continue through January. Combined with peak Cape summer, it makes a great trip.
events.costNotes: Peak summer flights and holiday-season rentals; South African food is cheap by US standards.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Salvador, Brazil","event":"Lavagem do Bonfim (around Jan 14)","note":"A huge street procession of white-clad devotees washing church steps, with plenty of music."},{"destination":"New Orleans, USA","event":"Twelfth Night kickoff of Carnival season (Jan 6)","note":"Parades, brass bands and king cake mark the start of the season."}]

events.event: Cabalgata de Reyes Magos de Alcoy
events.hook: Spain's oldest Three Kings parade, with live camels and a whole mountain town turned into a Nativity story.
events.overview: Alcoy has staged its Three Kings cavalcade since 1885, with the Kings arriving on Jan 4-5 amid shepherds, pages and hundreds of costumed participants. The evening parade ends with children's gifts and a lot of sweets. It is a small-town, family-oriented alternative to the big-city versions, and Valencia and the Costa Blanca are close by.
events.costNotes: Fly into Alicante or Valencia in the post-holiday lull; a rental car helps.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Seville, Spain","event":"Cabalgata de Reyes Magos (Jan 5)","note":"A larger city parade with a famous candy-throwing tradition."},{"destination":"Mexico City, Mexico","event":"Día de Reyes with Rosca de Reyes (Jan 6)","note":"Shared sweet bread and big public celebrations at the Zócalo."}]

events.event: Harbin International Ice and Snow Festival
events.hook: Skyscraper-sized ice castles glow in rainbow LEDs at -20°C in the world's largest ice festival.
events.overview: Hundreds of artists carve whole palaces and towers from Songhua River ice and compacted snow. At Harbin Ice-Snow World, night illumination, ice slides, ice lanterns and winter swimming make it truly spectacular. Individual attractions may open before the official Jan 5 opening and run through February, so the dates are approximate.
events.costNotes: Cheap lodging and food; flights typically connect via Beijing or Shanghai; pack serious cold-weather gear.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Chagan Lake, China","event":"Winter Fishing Festival (late Dec - Jan)","note":"A centuries-old tradition of hauling nets through the frozen lake."},{"destination":"Tromsø, Norway","event":"Aurora season and Sami winter culture","note":"A different kind of winter spectacle with northern lights and reindeer."}]

events.hook: White-robed pilgrims escort replica Arks of the Covenant to Fasilides' Bath for the most vivid baptism festival on earth.
events.overview: Timkat is the biggest festival of Ethiopian Orthodox Christianity. Priests carry tabots in processions with umbrellas, chants and drums, and the Gondar celebration culminates in a mass re-baptism at the 17th-century castle pool. A rare, authentic cultural festival with few tourists.
events.costNotes: Flights via Addis Ababa; add domestic flights and guides; book hotels early for the festival.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lalibela, Ethiopia","event":"Genna (Ethiopian Christmas, Jan 7)","note":"A pilgrimage to the rock-hewn churches, best before Timkat."},{"destination":"Addis Ababa, Ethiopia","event":"Timkat at Jan Meda","note":"The capital's big procession is easier to reach, though less intimate."}]

events.hook: Tennis's Grand Slam of Asia-Pacific opens the year with night sessions in the Melbourne summer heat.
events.overview: Two weeks of tennis at Melbourne Park, with the world's best players in grounds-pass chaos, live music and food stalls. Early rounds are very affordable and offer more access to top players. Combine it with the Great Ocean Road or the Yarra Valley.
events.costNotes: Peak summer and event pricing; ground passes are cheaper than reserved seating.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Tamworth, Australia","event":"Tamworth Country Music Festival (mid to late Jan)","note":"Ten days of free street gigs and buskers in outback Australia."},{"destination":"Auckland, New Zealand","event":"ASB Classic and summer festivals","note":"A cheaper, quieter tennis warm-up before the Slam."}]

events.hook: The famous indie film festival leaves Utah and debuts against the Rocky Mountain skyline in Boulder.
events.overview: After decades in Park City, Sundance moves to Boulder, Colorado, in 2027 for screenings, Q&As and premieres. The new location is a chance to see how a long-running festival reinvents itself. Dates and venues are still being confirmed, so check before booking.
events.costNotes: Short flights but very high festival-week lodging prices.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Palm Springs, USA","event":"Palm Springs International Film Festival (early Jan)","note":"A drive from LAX, with desert sunshine and awards-season premieres."},{"destination":"Rotterdam, Netherlands","event":"International Film Festival Rotterdam (late Jan - early Feb)","note":"Adventurous arthouse cinema in a design-forward city."}]

events.hook: The world's biggest free literary festival fills a Rajasthani palace garden with Nobel winners and chai.
events.overview: Held at Diggi Palace, the festival brings together hundreds of authors, thinkers and musicians from across the world. It's free and crowded, with evening concerts and plenty of Jaipur's palaces, forts and bazaars nearby. Dates are an estimate and shift each year, so verify before booking.
events.costNotes: Festival-week hotels sell out early; Indian food and local transport are cheap.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Ahmedabad, India","event":"International Kite Festival / Uttarayan (Jan 14)","note":"The sky fills with kites across Gujarat."},{"destination":"Galle, Sri Lanka","event":"Galle Literary Festival (January)","note":"A smaller, beachside literary gathering in a Dutch fort."}]

events.hook: Over a million devotees climb 272 steps to the Batu Caves in an intense Hindu pilgrimage.
events.overview: Thaipusam honors Lord Murugan with a silver chariot procession from KL to Batu Caves, where devotees carry milk pots and kavadi to the temple cave. It is deeply moving and intense, but be respectful. Date falls on the full moon of the Tamil month of Thai, so confirm with local calendars.
events.costNotes: Cheap eats; flights typically connect via Asia hubs; stay near the KL Sentral rail station.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"George Town, Malaysia","event":"Penang Thaipusam","note":"A smaller, quieter alternative with a chariot procession."},{"destination":"Chennai, India","event":"Pongal harvest festival (Jan 14-17)","note":"A Tamil harvest festival with kolam art, rice and bull sports."}]

events.hook: Nearly a thousand torch-bearing 'Vikings' burn a replica longship in Shetland's midwinter fire festival.
events.overview: Every last Tuesday of January, Lerwick's Guizer Jarl squad and about 900 costumed men march through the streets before torching a galley. The night then moves through private halls with performances and dancing. It's a community event rather than a tourist show, and visitors are welcomed into the halls as guests or via public tickets.
events.costNotes: Flights via London, Edinburgh or Aberdeen plus a Shetland hop; accommodation is tight around the event.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kirkwall, United Kingdom","event":"The Ba' Game (Jan 1)","note":"A huge, rowdy street football match in Orkney."},{"destination":"Reykjavik, Iceland","event":"Þorrablót begins (Jan 22)","note":"A midwinter feast of fermented shark and singing."}]

events.hook: Bonhomme the snowman rules ten days of ice palaces, night parades and canoe races on the frozen St. Lawrence.
events.overview: The world's largest winter carnival fills Old Quebec with snow sculptures, ice slides, night parades and the traditional hot caribou drink. Dates are based on the usual pattern of late January to early February, so check before you book. The city is scenic, and the cold is part of the fun.
events.costNotes: Flights usually connect via Montreal, Toronto or a US hub; carnival-weekend rooms are pricey.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Ottawa, Canada","event":"Winterlude (late Jan - Feb)","note":"Skate the Rideau Canal and visit the ice sculptures."},{"destination":"Aspen, USA","event":"Winter X Games (late Jan)","note":"Elite snowboard and ski competition with concerts."}]

events.hook: Giant snow sculptures glow over Odori Park while Hokkaido ramen and crab warm you up.
events.overview: Odori Park fills with enormous snow and ice sculptures, some the size of buildings, lit up each night. Tsudome and Susukino add snow slides and ice-carving competitions. Pair it with Hokkaido's powder skiing and seafood for a classic winter trip.
events.costNotes: Festival week is peak season in Sapporo, so book flights and lodging early; the festival is free to enter.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Yokote, Japan","event":"Yokote Kamakura Snow Hut Festival (mid-Feb)","note":"Hundreds of glowing snow huts in a quieter Akita town."},{"destination":"Harbin, China","event":"Harbin International Ice and Snow Festival","note":"Monumental ice architecture, still running in February."}]

events.hook: Krewe parades, marching bands and king cake build to Fat Tuesday on Feb 9.
events.overview: The final weekend brings the biggest parades: Endymion, Bacchus, Zulu and Rex. Add Mardi Gras Indians, brass bands and Creole food. It is the closest world-class carnival to LAX.
events.costNotes: A short flight, but Mardi Gras lodging has steep minimum stays and premiums.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Mobile, USA","event":"Mobile Mardi Gras","note":"America's oldest carnival, with family-friendly parades."},{"destination":"Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago","event":"Trinidad Carnival (Feb 8-9)","note":"Soca, steel pan and elaborate costume bands on Monday and Tuesday."}]

events.hook: Samba schools, sequins and a million revelers: the world's biggest party.
events.overview: The top-tier samba schools parade through the Sambadrome while hundreds of street blocos take over neighborhoods from Ipanema to Centro. Ash Wednesday falls on Feb 10, 2027, so the main weekend is Feb 6-9. It is a bucket-list spectacle, though prices and crowds peak.
events.costNotes: Carnival lodging prices run roughly double normal; Sambadrome tickets are included in the activity budget.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Salvador, Brazil","event":"Salvador Carnival","note":"Giant trio elétrico trucks and Afro-Brazilian blocos in a street-party format."},{"destination":"Olinda and Recife, Brazil","event":"Pernambuco Carnival","note":"Giant puppets and frevo dancing on cobbled hills, less polished and more local."}]

events.event: Lunar New Year (Year of the Goat)
events.hook: Night parades, harbor fireworks and flower markets welcome the Year of the Goat.
events.overview: Lunar New Year's Day is Feb 6, 2027. Hong Kong marks it with a Tsim Sha Tsui night parade, Victoria Harbour fireworks, Victoria Park flower markets and temple visits to Wong Tai Sin. The food, from turnip cake to dim sum banquets, is a draw in itself.
events.costNotes: Holiday week pushes hotel and flight prices up; expect crowds on Feb 6-8.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Hanoi, Vietnam","event":"Tet Nguyen Dan","note":"Peach blossoms and family festivities in Vietnam's biggest holiday, when many shops close."},{"destination":"Singapore","event":"River Hongbao and Chingay Parade","note":"Lantern displays and a street parade in a very easy city to visit."}]

events.hook: Devil dancers and Andean folklore in a UNESCO-listed Carnival at 12,000 feet.
events.overview: Some 28,000 dancers and musicians parade for about 20 hours in the Entrada, honoring the Virgen del Socavón with diablada devil dances, morenada and caporales. It is one of South America's great folk festivals and far less touristy than Rio. Base yourself in La Paz or Oruro and acclimatize first.
events.costNotes: Bleacher seats along the route, buses and a La Paz extension are included; flights to La Paz are the main cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Barranquilla, Colombia","event":"Carnaval de Barranquilla (Feb 6-9)","note":"Colombia's UNESCO-listed Carnival with cumbia, costumes and the Battle of Flowers."},{"destination":"Puno, Peru","event":"Virgen de la Candelaria Festival","note":"Lake Titicaca's huge folk-dance festival, with the main days in early February."}]

events.hook: Thousands of plumed Gilles dance through a small Belgian town and toss oranges at the crowd.
events.overview: This UNESCO-listed Carnival peaks on Shrove Tuesday (Feb 9), when 1,000+ Gilles in ostrich-feather hats march to drums and throw blood oranges. It is one of Europe's oldest and most authentic folk traditions, with few tourists. Base in Brussels and take the train.
events.costNotes: Cheapest if you stay in Brussels or Mons and use trains for day trips.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Aalst, Belgium","event":"Aalst Carnaval","note":"Satirical floats and a famously irreverent parade over the same weekend."},{"destination":"Cologne, Germany","event":"Rosenmontag Parade (Feb 8)","note":"Germany's biggest street carnival, with a huge parade and costumed crowds."}]

events.event: Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras
events.hook: Oxford Street turns into a rainbow runway in one of the world's great Pride parades.
events.overview: A two-week festival of parties, art and community events leads up to the Saturday-night parade down Oxford Street, expected on Feb 27. Late-summer weather suits harbor swims and beach days between events.
events.costNotes: Peak summer pricing; the long flight is the biggest cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Adelaide, Australia","event":"Adelaide Fringe (starts mid-Feb)","note":"One of the world's largest fringe festivals, with hundreds of shows."},{"destination":"Bay of Islands, New Zealand","event":"Waitangi Day (Feb 6)","note":"NZ's national day at the historic treaty grounds."}]

events.hook: At 4 a.m. every light in Basel goes dark and the lantern-lit piccolo cliques march.
events.overview: The Morgestraich begins at 4 a.m. on the Monday after Ash Wednesday, with illuminated lanterns and fife-and-drum cliques moving through the old town. Three days of satirical parades, masks and flour soup follow. It is a Protestant-region carnival unlike any other, and Basel is a short trip from Zurich.
events.costNotes: Switzerland is expensive; flying into Zurich or Basel and using the rail pass keeps transport reasonable.

events.hook: Hundreds of thousands of wildebeest calves are born in just a few weeks, and predators follow.
events.overview: The southern Serengeti plains around Ndutu host about 500,000 calves born over a few weeks, with peak births in mid to late February. Lions, cheetahs and hyenas hunt among the herds, so the wildlife viewing is intense. Book camps and guides months ahead.
events.costNotes: Park fees and a safari vehicle make activities the biggest cost; camps replace Airbnbs here.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Maui, USA","event":"Humpback whale season peak","note":"Whales are most active off Maui in February, with a short flight from LAX."},{"destination":"Angangueo, Mexico","event":"Monarch butterfly overwintering","note":"Millions of monarchs cluster in Michoacán's oyamel forests in February."}]

events.event: Lantern Festival and Pingxi Sky Lanterns
events.hook: Thousands of wish-lanterns rise from railway tracks to close out Lunar New Year.
events.overview: The Lantern Festival falls on Feb 20, 2027, the 15th day of the lunar year. Pingxi releases sky lanterns along the old rail line, while Taiwan's main lantern show draws crowds to its host city. Base in Taipei for night markets, hot springs and the mountain towns.
events.costNotes: Taiwan is great value; the main cost is the flight.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Colombo, Sri Lanka","event":"Navam Perahera (Feb full moon)","note":"Elephants, drummers and dancers at Gangaramaya Temple on the February full moon."},{"destination":"Hoi An, Vietnam","event":"Full Moon Lantern Night (Feb 20)","note":"The old town goes electricity-free for lanterns on the river."}]

events.hook: A whole city fills with giant satirical sculptures and burns them in one roaring night.
events.overview: Valencia spends March on daily mascletà firecracker barrages, street parties and the Ofrenda flower procession. Then comes the Plantà of hundreds of monumental papier-mâché falles, and on March 19 the Cremà burns them all. It is a UNESCO-listed spectacle of fire, noise and paella.
events.costNotes: Flights usually connect via Madrid or another European hub, and Fallas week lodging runs about 40% above normal.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Castellón de la Plana, Spain","event":"Magdalena Festival","note":"A smaller Valencian fiesta with parades and fireworks in early March, with far fewer crowds."},{"destination":"Florence, Italy","event":"Scoppio del Carro (Easter Sunday, Mar 28)","note":"A 350-year-old exploding cart ritual in front of the Duomo, for a similar fire-and-tradition feel."}]

events.event: Nyepi (Balinese Day of Silence) and Ogoh-Ogoh Parades
events.hook: Bali's monster-effigy parades end in a full 24 hours of island-wide silence.
events.overview: The Melasti purification rites and the Ogoh-Ogoh parade of demon effigies on the eve are loud and vivid. Then Nyepi shuts down the whole island, including the airport, with no lights, traffic or noise. It is one of the most unusual new-year observances in the world.
events.costNotes: Nyepi falls in the wet season, so lodging is cheap, but expect to stay put on the day itself.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lombok, Indonesia","event":"Nyepi observed by Lombok's Balinese Hindu community","note":"A quieter way to see the Ogoh-Ogoh and silence traditions, with good beaches."},{"destination":"Hoi An, Vietnam","event":"Monthly Full Moon Lantern Night (Mar 22)","note":"The old town switches off its lights for lanterns on the water."}]

events.hook: Four days of world music under the gums in Botanic Park.
events.overview: WOMADelaide brings artists from dozens of countries to the city's Botanic Park, alongside global food stalls and a relaxed outdoor crowd. It overlaps with the tail of the Adelaide Fringe and Festival season, so the city is buzzing. The Barossa and McLaren Vale wine regions are an easy side trip.
events.costNotes: Festival season pushes up Adelaide accommodation, and the 12-night stay includes Fringe and wine-region days.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Melbourne, Australia","event":"Australian Grand Prix (early March)","note":"Season-opening F1 at Albert Park, with the city's food scene as a bonus."},{"destination":"Auckland, New Zealand","event":"Auckland Arts Festival (March)","note":"A three-week programme of music, theatre and dance on the harbour."}]

events.hook: Film, music and tech collide across Austin for ten days.
events.overview: SXSW fills the city with film premieres, thousands of showcase gigs, keynotes and startup launches. The unofficial parties and Texas barbecue are half the appeal. Dates are estimated from the usual mid-March slot.
events.costNotes: Cheap flights, but festival-week Airbnb rates roughly double.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Miami, USA","event":"Ultra Music Festival / Miami Music Week (late March)","note":"Electronic music takeover of Bayfront Park, with a week of pool parties."},{"destination":"Mexico City, Mexico","event":"Vive Latino (mid-March)","note":"Latin rock and alternative festival at Foro Sol, with a great food city around it."}]

events.hook: St Patrick's Day in the city that invented it, with a huge parade and a multi-day festival.
events.overview: Dublin's festival runs several days with street theatre, concerts, a céilí and a big parade on March 17. Pubs throughout Temple Bar and beyond run live trad sessions. Day trips to Newgrange or the Wicklow hills make a good break from the crowds.
events.costNotes: Peak-week hotel and Airbnb pricing, and flights usually go via a US or European hub.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Cheltenham, England","event":"Cheltenham Festival (Mar 16-19)","note":"Four days of top-level National Hunt racing with a heavy Irish crowd."},{"destination":"Savannah, USA","event":"St. Patrick's Day Parade (Mar 17)","note":"One of America's biggest St. Patrick's Day celebrations, with an easy domestic flight."}]

events.event: Holi in Braj (Lathmar Holi to Holi)
events.hook: Colour, flower petals and playful sticks fill Krishna's hometown in the week before Holi.
events.overview: The Braj region celebrates Holi for days, with Lathmar Holi in Barsana, Phoolon Wali Holi with flower petals in Vrindavan, and the main Holi on March 22. It is the most intense version of the festival and the one pilgrims travel for. Delhi and Agra make easy bookends to the trip.
events.costNotes: Cheap on the ground, with flights via the Gulf or Europe to Delhi, plus a car or train to Mathura.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Samarkand, Uzbekistan","event":"Navruz (Mar 20-21)","note":"Persian new year with music, sumalak and folk games in the Registan."},{"destination":"Kathmandu, Nepal","event":"Fagu Purnima (Holi)","note":"Nepal's own Holi, with colour-throwing around Basantapur Durbar Square."}]

events.hook: Colonial streets are covered in sawdust and flower carpets, then trampled by processions.
events.overview: Antigua's Holy Week is among the most celebrated in Latin America. Locals spend hours making intricate alfombras from dyed sawdust, flowers and fruit. Then purple-robed cucuruchos carry huge floats over them to incense and a funeral-march band, against a backdrop of volcanoes.
events.costNotes: Nonstop flights from LAX to Guatemala City, then a short shuttle, with Holy Week lodging at a premium.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Popayán, Colombia","event":"Semana Santa processions (UNESCO)","note":"Candlelit night processions in a white colonial city."},{"destination":"Taxco, Mexico","event":"Holy Week processions","note":"Hooded penitents and silver-town streets, a much shorter trip from LAX."}]

events.hook: Tokyo's parks turn pink and everyone has a picnic under the trees.
events.overview: Full bloom in Tokyo usually arrives in the last week of March, with hanami picnics in Ueno, Shinjuku Gyoen and along the Meguro River, plus night illuminations. Forecasts shift year to year, so staying flexible helps. Kyoto and Osaka peak a few days later, so a rail extension extends the show.
events.costNotes: Sakura season is a peak-price window for flights and lodging.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kyoto, Japan","event":"Cherry blossom peak (about Mar 28-Apr 5)","note":"Temples, canals and the Philosopher's Path peak a few days after Tokyo."},{"destination":"Washington, DC, USA","event":"National Cherry Blossom Festival (about Mar 20-Apr 11)","note":"Tidal Basin blooms with an easy domestic flight."}]

events.hook: Candlelit processions, hooded penitents and thundering brass fill Seville's streets all week.
events.overview: From Palm Sunday to Easter Sunday, brotherhoods carry ornate pasos through the old town to saeta songs and drumbeats. The Madrugá before Good Friday is the most intense night. Spring blossom and orange trees add to the atmosphere.
events.costNotes: Easter-week rates apply, and flights via Madrid or another hub are cheaper if booked early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Málaga, Spain","event":"Semana Santa (Mar 21-28)","note":"Huge tronos carried by hundreds of bearers, with a coastal setting."},{"destination":"Trapani, Italy","event":"Procession of the Mysteries (Good Friday, Mar 26)","note":"A 24-hour Sicilian procession with a 400-year history."}]

events.hook: Temples, canals and lantern-lit paths turn pink for one fleeting week.
events.overview: Full bloom (mankai) in Kyoto usually lands between late March and the first week of April. Philosopher's Path, Maruyama Park and Daigo-ji are the classic viewing spots, with evening illuminations and picnics under the trees. The exact peak shifts by a few days each year, so build in a buffer.
events.costNotes: Peak-bloom lodging in Kyoto is the most expensive of the year.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Takayama, Japan","event":"Takayama Spring Festival (Sanno Matsuri), Apr 14-15","note":"Ornate festival floats and mechanical puppets in a preserved Edo-era town."},{"destination":"Washington, D.C., USA","event":"National Cherry Blossom Festival","note":"Tidal Basin blossoms with a shorter, cheaper trip from LAX; the peak usually falls in late March or early April."}]

events.hook: Mexico's biggest fair is three weeks of bullfights, charreada, concerts and mariachi.
events.overview: Aguascalientes' San Marcos fair is one of Mexico's oldest and largest, with a huge cultural program, rodeos, free concerts and food stalls. Few foreign visitors come, so it feels authentic and costs little. The dates shift slightly each year, so check once the program is released.
events.costNotes: A short flight and low Mexican prices keep this the cheapest trip on the list.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Guanajuato, Mexico","event":"Colonial city festivities and student estudiantinas","note":"A colorful UNESCO city with callejoneadas, a good add-on by road."},{"destination":"Oaxaca, Mexico","event":"Spring food and mezcal season","note":"Not time-locked, but a strong cultural stop with the same flight profile."}]

events.hook: The world's biggest water fight doubles as a Thai New Year blessing.
events.overview: Chiang Mai's moat becomes a citywide water battle, with temple ceremonies, Buddha-washing and parades alongside it. Locals often stretch the holiday to a week. Pack waterproof gear and book early, as the city is full.
events.costNotes: Thailand stays cheap on the ground, but Songkran flights and rooms are pricey.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Luang Prabang, Laos","event":"Pii Mai Lao (Lao New Year), Apr 14-16","note":"A gentler, more ceremonial version of Songkran with processions and sand stupas."},{"destination":"Siem Reap, Cambodia","event":"Khmer New Year (Choul Chnam Thmey), Apr 14-16","note":"Temple blessings and street parties around Angkor."}]

events.hook: A week of flamenco dresses, sherry and horse carriages in a tent city of casetas.
events.overview: Seville's Feria begins with the lighting of thousands of lanterns on the fairground and runs for six days of dancing sevillanas, eating tapas and drinking rebujito. The dates fall two weeks after Easter. Many casetas are private, so go with local contacts or visit the public ones.
events.costNotes: Feria week pushes Seville rentals up sharply.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Barcelona, Spain","event":"Sant Jordi Day (Apr 23)","note":"The city fills with book stalls and roses on a day Catalans treat like a lovers' holiday."},{"destination":"Jerez de la Frontera, Spain","event":"Feria del Caballo (usually May)","note":"A smaller Andalusian fair centered on horses and sherry, but it is outside April."}]

events.hook: The world's oldest annual marathon, run through cheering crowds from Hopkinton to Boylston Street.
events.overview: Patriots' Day Monday brings a Red Sox morning game and the marathon, with crowds six deep along Heartbreak Hill and Wellesley's scream tunnel. Spectating is free, and the city has a festive, historic feel all weekend. Hotels and rentals fill months ahead.
events.costNotes: Marathon-weekend pricing makes housing the big cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Concord, USA","event":"Patriots' Day Battle Road reenactments","note":"Revolutionary War reenactments at Lexington and Concord the same morning."},{"destination":"Toronto, Canada","event":"Spring hockey playoffs","note":"Playoff-season city energy, with no fixed dates."}]

events.hook: Two weekends of jazz, gospel, zydeco and crawfish at the Fair Grounds.
events.overview: Jazz Fest fills the Fair Grounds with over a dozen stages of Louisiana music and food, and the city's clubs hold late-night shows after. It runs over two weekends, usually the last Thursday of April through the first Sunday of May. The lineup is announced in winter and the big acts sell out fast.
events.costNotes: Includes multi-day festival tickets and rideshares.

events.hook: Blossoms ring a castle moat, and fallen petals turn the water pink.
events.overview: Northern Japan's blossoms peak weeks after Kyoto's. Hirosaki Park has about 2,600 trees around the castle, with food stalls and night illuminations. It is a good way to see sakura if you miss the southern bloom, and it is far quieter than Kyoto.
events.costNotes: Includes domestic flights or rail to Aomori and regional transport.

events.hook: Floats built from millions of hyacinths, daffodils and tulips roll from Noordwijk to Haarlem.
events.overview: The Bollenstreek parade is a one-day flower-float procession, held on a Saturday in late April, through the Dutch bulb fields. The tulip fields and Keukenhof Gardens are in peak bloom around it, and Amsterdam makes an easy base. Check the parade date once published, as it may shift a week.
events.costNotes: Amsterdam-area lodging in tulip season is expensive.

events.hook: Candlelit epitaph processions and the Holy Saturday pot-smashing make Greece's biggest holiday.
events.overview: Orthodox Easter falls on May 2, 2027, so Holy Week starts on April 25. Corfu has Good Friday epitaph processions with brass bands, pots thrown from balconies on Holy Saturday morning, and midnight resurrection celebrations. Roast lamb and family feasts follow on Easter Sunday.
events.costNotes: Includes a connection in Athens or elsewhere in Europe.

events.event: Anzac Day Dawn Service and March
events.hook: Tens of thousands gather in the dark at Martin Place for Australia's most solemn national day.
events.overview: Anzac Day marks the 1915 Gallipoli landings with a dawn service, veterans' marches and the tradition of two-up in pubs. Sydney's Cenotaph service starts before sunrise, followed by a large march through the CBD. It also makes a good base for autumn days at the beaches and harbor.
events.costNotes: Sydney is pricey, and the ANZAC long weekend can lift rentals.

events.hook: Two minutes of racing wrapped in hats, mint juleps and a century and a half of Southern pageantry.
events.overview: The Kentucky Derby at Churchill Downs is held on the first Saturday of May. Derby Week brings fireworks, steamboat races and bourbon-trail tastings, and the infield and the Millionaires Row hat parade are a spectacle of their own. It is one of the great single-day events in American sport.
events.costNotes: Derby-week lodging and grandstand tickets drive the cost; a 12-day stay can include Kentucky bourbon country.

events.hook: Hundreds of thousands of tulips bloom along the Rideau Canal, a thank-you gift from the Dutch royal family.
events.overview: Ottawa's tulip festival began as thanks for the Netherlands' wartime refuge in Canada, and it is the largest tulip festival in the world. Commissioners Park fills with color, with concerts and markets alongside, and the capital's museums and canal are nearby. Bloom timing shifts with the weather, so the dates are estimated.
events.costNotes: Flights to Ottawa usually connect; the festival itself is mostly free.

events.hook: Red-carpet premieres and Palme d'Or drama on the French Riviera.
events.overview: The world's most glamorous film festival fills the Croisette with premieres, yacht parties and star-spotting. Most screenings are for accredited guests, but you can watch the red-carpet arrivals and the open-air beach cinema. Combine it with day trips along the Côte d'Azur.
events.costNotes: Riviera accommodation more than doubles in festival weeks; staying in Nice or Antibes saves money.

events.event: Fez Festival of World Sacred Music
events.hook: Sufi chanting, gospel and global spiritual music in the world's largest medieval medina.
events.overview: For over 30 years this festival has brought sacred and spiritual music from many traditions to Fez's palaces, courtyards and Bab Makina. Concerts are paired with talks and Sufi nights. The medina's tanneries, madrasas and mint tea make it a rich cultural trip. Dates move from year to year, so check the final announcement.
events.costNotes: A riad-style stay is cheap; flights usually connect via Casablanca or Europe.

events.hook: A 1,400-year-old procession of 500 people in Heian-era court dress winds through Kyoto.
events.overview: Aoi Matsuri is one of Kyoto's three great festivals. Ox-drawn carriages and courtiers adorned with hollyhock leaves travel from the Imperial Palace to Shimogamo and Kamigamo shrines. Paid seating gives the best view, and the surrounding shrines and spring greenery make it a calm, beautiful day. The procession is postponed one day if it rains.
events.costNotes: Kyoto prices are moderate in May; a rail pass may be worth it for side trips.

events.hook: A whole nation in folk dress, with children's parades, brass bands and ice cream in the long spring light.
events.overview: On May 17 Oslo is packed with people in bunad costumes. The children's parade passes the Royal Palace, where the royal family waves from the balcony. The city celebrates with hot dogs, ice cream and street parties that last into the evening. Bergen and the fjords make easy additions.
events.costNotes: Norway is expensive; flights usually connect in Europe.

events.hook: The world's most famous garden show, with show gardens, rare blooms and royal visitors.
events.overview: The Royal Horticultural Society's show takes over the Royal Hospital grounds with elaborate gardens and floral displays. It is five days of botanical design that influences gardens worldwide. Tickets sell out well ahead, and the city offers theatre, museums and Kew Gardens for the rest of the trip.
events.costNotes: London lodging is pricey; tickets sell out in advance.

events.hook: Colombo glows with lanterns, pandals and free food stalls for the holiest day in Sri Lanka's Buddhist calendar.
events.overview: Vesak marks the birth, enlightenment and death of the Buddha, and falls on the full moon in May. Streets fill with illuminated pandals and lanterns, and communities offer free food (dansal) to visitors. Kandy's Temple of the Tooth and Colombo's Gangaramaya temple are focal points. Exact dates follow the full moon, so they are approximate.
events.costNotes: Cheap on the ground; flights usually connect via the Gulf or Asia.

events.hook: Light sculptures, projections and music turn Sydney Harbour into an open-air gallery.
events.overview: Vivid Sydney lights up the Opera House sails, Circular Quay and the CBD with projections and installations, alongside concerts and talks. It runs through the cooler start of Australian winter. The dates are estimated from previous years' schedules.
events.costNotes: Long-haul flights are pricey and Vivid weeks push up hotel rates.

events.hook: Thirty-three cars, 500 miles and 300,000 fans at the Greatest Spectacle in Racing.
events.overview: The Indy 500 is held on the Sunday of Memorial Day weekend and has a tradition that includes the pre-race ceremonies, the milk for the winner and the infield party. It is one of motorsport's top events, and race week has practice, qualifying and a parade downtown.
events.costNotes: Race-weekend lodging and grandstand tickets raise costs; the stay can include other Midwest stops.

events.hook: Wildebeest herds by the hundreds of thousands pour through crocodile-filled rivers in the western Serengeti.
events.overview: In June the migration heads through the western corridor and the Grumeti River while the calving season ends. Crossings are dramatic but timing depends on rains and herd movement. Dry-season game drives also give excellent big-cat sightings.
events.costNotes: Safari lodges, park fees and bush flights drive the costs; Airbnb choices are limited.

events.hook: Drums pound and crews pull hard as dragon boats race across Victoria Harbour and Stanley Bay.
events.overview: The Dragon Boat Festival falls on the 5th day of the 5th lunar month. Races are held at Stanley, Sha Tin and Tsim Sha Tsui, and zongzi rice dumplings are everywhere. Hong Kong's food, hiking and harbour skyline fill out the rest of the trip.
events.costNotes: June is hot and humid, which keeps flights moderate; the festival is a public holiday, so book housing early.

events.hook: Tens of thousands of dancers in wild costumes take over Sapporo in cool early-summer weather.
events.overview: Hundreds of teams perform fast, choreographed dances with naruko clappers on stages and streets across the city. It is far less touristed than Japan's big summer matsuri, and Hokkaido's seafood and ramen suit the trip. Escape Honshu's rainy season here.
events.costNotes: Flights usually route via Tokyo; hotels book up on festival weekends.

events.hook: Twenty-four hours of flat-out endurance racing, with a campsite party running the whole time.
events.overview: The world's most famous endurance race fills the Circuit de la Sarthe with prototypes, GT cars and a huge camping crowd. Come for the Saturday-afternoon start, the night stints and the Sunday finish. Add Loire Valley châteaux and Normandy on the same trip.
events.costNotes: Race week pushes up local lodging; the experiential figure includes grandstand tickets and a rental car.

events.hook: Masked lama dancers swirl through a Himalayan monastery courtyard at 3,500 meters.
events.overview: Hemis Monastery marks the birth of Guru Padmasambhava with cham masked dances, long horns and monks in brocade. It is held in Ladakh's short summer window, when mountain passes are open. Add Pangong Lake, Nubra Valley and high-altitude trekking. The dates follow the Tibetan lunar calendar, so confirm closer to travel.
events.costNotes: Flights go via Delhi, then a domestic hop to Leh; rooms in town are cheap.
